sketch_notes: Both sketches depict a simple static landing page layout with an image, headline/body text, and a single call-to-action button. There are no visible indicators of menus, overlays, tabs, accordions, search, form fields, sticky behavior, loading mechanisms, or other components that imply JavaScript-driven interaction. The only actionable element appears to be a standard button/link, which does not by itself require any of the listed JavaScript patterns. Cross-viewport differences are purely responsive layout changes from stacked mobile composition to side-by-side desktop composition.
